title: Imp Jar & Zeus Bolt Peach Lemon 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Peach Lemon by Imp Jar and Zeus Juice is a bright and uplifting blend, combining the juicy sweetness of peaches with the crisp, citrusy tang of lemon. This e-liquid delivers a refreshing vape that perfectly captures the essence of both fruits, offering a harmonious mix that invigorates the palate with each puff. This e-liquid is a testament to simple, perfected pleasures, making it a delightful treat at any time. Joining forces, Imp Jar's balanced 50/50 e-liquids and Zeus Juice's exceptional flavour craftsmanship result in a versatile e-liquid suitable for various vaping devices. Whether you prefer pod systems or starter kits, this 50PG/50VG blend offers an ideal vaping experience with ample flavour and cloud production. Each 60ml shortfill bottle contains 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, plus 10ml space for a nicotine shot. Adding a 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot creates 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing for personalized nicotine strength. It's a perfect option for those seeking both high-quality flavour and the flexibility to adjust nicotine content.
